notes.title: 🚨 Supercar Collection Simulator is OUT - PLAY NOW with 9 Release Exclusive Cars
notes.content:
Collectors, the day has arrived.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45523427/245a1ba346be862c194bc5c5f0b87eac6196c5c2.jpg

This is not just a sneak peek, it’s the real deal. A deeper, more polished, and much bigger experience awaits.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453600/Supercar_Collection_Simulator/

What you are going to find in release:

🕰️ Limited-Time Classics
To celebrate the launch, 9 vintage supercars are available to add to your collection — but only for 3 days! After that, you'll have to chase them down in races to add them to your collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45523427/c2c7152f78a5a080b16796aafeb4318ddad49e0e.png

🃏 Skill Card Packs
Open packs, build your strategy, and activate unique abilities mid-race to win.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/a4180f1b5ecf807faeb8f87f22598ce584894029.gif

🔧 Build and customize your dream garage
Design your perfect space, organize your collection, and make it your own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/93d60dfe44583d0540ef5bc7f4a47d62dddfde42.gif

🏎️ Race your customers
Go head-to-head with other collectors in competitive, quick-fire races.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/7a074706b383ad4cfcd176a097688749be801b60.gif

🃏 Multiplayer Trade Battles
Challenge your Steam friends, snatch their best cards, and expand your legendary lineup.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c53a5f73445b7f70e21a740373ee3b33f55e56b0.gif

🔍 Hunt down rare and legendary supercars
Open packs, scout the market, and track down the rarest cars from around the globe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/2ccb74485a6d3027543e37a2185417d6bfe5f2ee.gif

🪧 Name Your Store 
Your brand, your legacy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/93d60dfe44583d0540ef5bc7f4a47d62dddfde42.gif

👥 And that’s just launch day.
We’re only getting started; new features, updates, events, and secret drops are coming throughout Early Access. And your feedback is what will shape this world.

👉 Play now. Build your collection. Let the collection passion begin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/58bd0d5ff8eb0ccd34e2c2479845ceedb159c8e8.png

notes.title: Supercar Collection Simulator: Prologue - 6 Exclusive Supercars Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Buckle up because Supercar Collection Simulator: Prologue is coming on 24th of March!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/e2df3c38802477e88c018bc617b078d5e110b37e.png

This special preview gives you an exclusive first look into the world of high performance car collecting, while unlocking six stunning, limited-edition supercars, only available in the Prologue. 

These supercars feature a unique, block style design, inspired by the iconic brick based building toys.

💥 Wishlist Now, Ready to Race: Be sure to add Supercar Collection Simulator to your Steam wishlist now to guarantee you’re ready when the Prologue drops on March 24th. You won’t want to miss your shot at these exclusive supercars!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453570/Supercar_Collection_Simulator_Prologue/

🏎️ Claim Your Exclusive Rides: These six supercars won’t be available in the full game, making them a rare and valuable addition to your collection.

Mark your calendars, add Supercar Collection Simulator to your wishlist, and get ready to fuel your passion for rare supercars.

💬 Which of the exclusive Prologue cars will be your favourite?
